title: Demis Hassabis on what's next for Google DeepMind (Sources Live at Davos)
summary: 达沃斯现场观众前的对谈实录：Gemini 下一步、给 Siri 供模型的苹果合作、通往 AGI 还缺什么、Google Glass 回归与机器人。
title_zh: Demis Hassabis 谈 Google DeepMind 的下一步（达沃斯现场）

SubscribeSign inPlayback speed×Share postShare post at current time0:00/Paid episodeThe full episode is only available to paid subscribers of SourcesSubscribe to watchDemis Hassabis on what's next for Google DeepMindMy full Sources Live conversation with Google's AI chief during the World Economic Forum in Davos.Alex HeathJan 27, 2026∙ Paid1722ShareToday I’m publishing my full interview with Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis, which took place last week in front of a live audience at Brunswick Home on the sidelines of the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland.

We talked about what’s coming for Gemini, the new Apple partnership that will put Gemini behind Siri, competing with OpenAI, and what he believes is missing on the road to AGI. We also discussed the return of Google Glass, how he thinks the robotics market will develop, what he thinks of brain-computer-interfaces, and his timeline for AGI. As you’ll be able to tell, Hassabis is feeling confident about Google’s position in the AI race. At the same time, he’s more conservative about AI’s rate of progress than some of his peers.

This interview includes our exchange about advertising in AI chatbots, which went viral last week after I broke it out in the newsletter. Hassabis expressed surprise that OpenAI moved to ads “so early,” while noting that Google has no current plans to put them in Gemini.

Stay tuned for more of my Sources Live interviews in Davos over the coming days. And thanks to Disruptive for making this interview possible.

You can also watch this full interview on YouTube.

今天，我发布了对 Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis 的完整访谈，该访谈于上周在瑞士达沃斯世界经济论坛期间，在 Brunswick Home 的现场观众面前进行。

我们讨论了 Gemini 的未来动向、Apple 的新合作（将把 Gemini 接入 Siri）、与 OpenAI 的竞争，以及他认为在通往 AGI 的道路上还缺少什么。我们还讨论了 Google Glass 的回归、他对机器人市场发展的看法、他对 brain-computer-interfaces 的看法，以及他对 AGI 的时间线预测。正如你们将听到的，Hassabis 对 Google 在 AI 竞赛中的地位感到自信。与此同时，与一些同行相比，他对 AI 进展速度的看法更为保守。

本次访谈包含了我们关于 AI 聊天机器人中广告的交流，这部分内容上周被我单独摘发到通讯后引发了病毒式传播。Hassabis 对 OpenAI 如此早就转向广告表示惊讶，同时指出 Google 目前没有计划在 Gemini 中加入广告。

请继续关注，未来几天我还会发布更多在达沃斯进行的 Sources Live 访谈。感谢 Disruptive 让本次访谈得以实现。

你也可以在 YouTube 上观看完整访谈。
